claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, citalopram is unlikely to kill cancer cells through SERT inhibition; its most plausible cytotoxic mechanism is cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress/phospholipidosis, a physicochemical effect shared by many cationic amphiphilic drugs, though this is expected to be weak.
